therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: CD34+ selected allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation with haploidentical donor
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Allogeneic stem cell engraftment with CD34+ selection to reduce GVHD risk while maintaining graft-versus-tumor effect
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Hematopoietic reconstitution and immune system restoration with anti-tumor immunity

results.effect_size: 27 out of 41 participants achieved 1-year relapse-free survival (65.9%)
results.target_engagement_evidence: 37 out of 41 participants achieved successful engraftment (90.2%)
biomarker_changes: Median CD3/4 count at day 28: 41.3 cells/ul (95% CI: 9.0-417.0)
Median CD3/8 count at day 28: 48 cells/ul (95% CI: 7.9-1329.0)
Median CD3/4 count at day 90: 141 cells/ul (95% CI: 22-1374)
Median CD3/8 count at day 90: 384 cells/ul (95% CI: 8.4-3041)
safety_signals: Various other serious adverse events including diplopia, abdominal pain, C. diff infection, cardiac disorder
results.dose_information: Total-body irradiation, cyclophosphamide IV, mycophenolate mofetil IV, CD34+ selected stem cells, donor lymphocyte infusion
